title: Egypt: Fact-checking site’s entire newsroom jailed as assault on press freedom widens
keyFacts: Six journalists who make up the entire newsroom of the Egyptian fact-checking website Matsadash remain in detention, the UN human rights office (OHCHR) said on Tuesday, warning of proliferating assaults on press freedom by the Government.

title: COP31: Energy transition takes centre stage as countries map path beyond fossil fuels
keyFacts: The global energy transition took centre stage on the second day of COP31, as countries explored how to move away from fossil fuels, accelerate clean energy and overcome financial and infrastructure barriers standing in the way.
